headlines: TWO MIAMI MEN ARRESTED IN MOPED CHOP SHOP BUST
TRAFFIC STOP UNCOVERS STOLEN MOPED OPERATION
MISSING EYE PROTECTION LEADS DEPUTIES TO STOLEN MOPEDS
draft.article: Deputies arrested Sean Patrick O'Hara, 52, and Daniel Felix Perez, 44, on Thursday in northwest Miami-Dade following a traffic stop in the Pinewood area. Both men face felony vehicle theft and chop shop charges. An officer initially stopped O'Hara at Northwest 95th Street and Seventh Avenue for riding a moped without eye protection. The vehicle had a damaged ignition and turned out to be stolen from Miami on October 20. O'Hara directed deputies to Perez's residence at Colonial Acres Mobile Home Park on Northwest 10th Avenue, where authorities discovered a second stolen pink moped. Perez and O'Hara each blamed the other for the crimes. Both men were booked into Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center.

items.title: Miami Dade College Resumes Management and Operation of Tower Theater Miami on Nov. 1

headlines: MIAMI DADE COLLEGE RESUMES TOWER THEATER MANAGEMENT ON NOV 1
TOWER THEATER RETURNS TO MIAMI DADE COLLEGE
LITTLE HAVANA ICON PREPARES FOR HISTORIC CENTENNIAL REVIVAL
draft.article:
Miami Dade College is officially taking back management and operations of Little Havana's historic Tower Theater on Nov. 1. The college, which previously ran the Calle Ocho institution for over two decades, will oversee programming, rentals, and day-to-day operations through the Miami Film Festival.

The venue is temporarily closed for extensive improvements ahead of an anticipated early 2027 reopening. Upgrades include refreshed lounge areas, expanded concessions, a newly staffed box office, and a sound-transparent Cine LEDMAX screen, making it only the second cinema in the United States to feature the technology.

A centennial block party will celebrate the theater's 100th anniversary on Dec. 10, 2026.

items.desc: The fallout continues following a fight that broke out in Miami Beach Nautilus Middle School last month, all of it caught on camera.

headlines: MIAMI BEACH MIDDLE SCHOOL FIGHT LEADS TO FELONY BATTERY CHARGE
11-YEAR-OLD GIRL FACES JUDGE AFTER RECORDED SCHOOL ATTACK
WHAT HAPPENED BEFORE THE CAMERA ROLLED AT NAUTILUS MIDDLE?
draft.article:
An 11-year-old girl faced a judge on Thursday after a recorded fight last month at Miami Beach Nautilus Middle School. The student is charged with felony battery following footage showing her repeatedly punching, kicking, and pulling the hair of another 11-year-old girl until an administrator intervened. Her next court appearance is set for Dec. 21.

The mother of the accused student, Alba Castillo, stated her daughter is innocent and reacted only after enduring ongoing bullying and harassment. She has since enrolled her child in another school.

The victim's mother, Michelle Santos, left the court in tears, demanding justice. Santos stated her daughter suffered a concussion, bruises, and scalp cuts in what she described as a premeditated attack.

items.title: Man who shot, killed Miami Beach tourist as he protected family sentenced to 50 years in prison
items.desc: Tamarius Davis pleaded guilty to second-degree murder for the August 2021 shooting death of 21-year-old Dustin Wakefield.

headlines: GEORGIA MAN GETS 50 YEARS FOR SOUTH BEACH TOURIST MURDER
FIFTY YEARS IN PRISON FOR DEADLY SOUTH BEACH SHOOTING
JUSTICE FOR VISITING FAMILY TARGETED IN 2021 MIAMI BEACH ATTACK
draft.article:
A Georgia man received a 50-year Florida state prison sentence for an August 2021 shooting in South Beach that killed a visiting father.

Tamarius Davis pleaded guilty to second-degree murder for the death of 21-year-old Dustin Wakefield from Colorado. Authorities stated Davis took psychedelic mushrooms, obtained a gun, and opened fire on random individuals in South Beach. Davis then approached Wakefield, who was visiting with his wife, one-year-old son, and other relatives.

Prosecutors said Davis pointed his firearm at the infant before shooting Wakefield five times, later laughing and dancing.

Davis faces a mandatory 25-year minimum term, followed by 20 years of probation.

headlines: INTER MIAMI CF REVEALS 2027 SPRINT SEASON SCHEDULE
SOCCER RETURNS TO NU STADIUM THIS FEBRUARY
FOURTEEN MATCHES STAND BETWEEN INTER MIAMI AND A STAR
draft.article:
Inter Miami CF will open its 2027 MLS Sprint Season at Nu Stadium on Saturday, Feb. 19, taking on FC Cincinnati on home turf. The schedule features 14 regular season games, split evenly between seven home matches in South Florida and seven away fixtures, all against Eastern Conference rivals.

Fans heading to Nu Stadium will see home clashes against Nashville SC, Red Bull New York, D.C. United, Charlotte FC, Philadelphia Union, and CF Montréal. The club will also host dedicated nights honoring teachers, military personnel, first responders, women's empowerment, and youth fútbol.

The top eight teams qualify for a single-elimination postseason concluding on Memorial Day Weekend, crowning an MLS Cup champion with berths into the CONCACAF Champions Cup and Leagues Cup.

items.title: No. 1 Hurricanes getting early dividends from top freshman class
items.desc: The Hurricanes had a top-10 recruiting class last season, and Miami is getting crucial production from several freshmen.

headlines: NO. 1 MIAMI HURRICANES FRESHMEN LOG OVER 2,000 SNAPS
MIAMI FRESHMEN ARE SPARKING THE HURRICANES
LOCAL TALENT POWERS MIAMI TO TOP OF COLLEGE FOOTBALL
draft.article:
The No. 1 Miami Hurricanes are relying heavily on first-year players seven games into the season. Head coach Mario Cristobal has utilized 27 freshmen across offense and defense, accumulating 2,118 total snaps. That mark ranks second across the entire Power 4.

Offensively, running back Javian Mallory from West Boca Raton High leads Miami with 444 rushing yards and seven touchdowns, averaging 7.5 yards per carry. Massive 6-foot-8 lineman Ben Congdon has also started three straight games at left guard.

Defensively, back JJ Dunnigan has emerged as a key contributor. Dunnigan sits second on the team with 28 tackles, adding a sack, a forced fumble, a fumble recovery, and an interception returned for a touchdown.

KEY BISCAYNE SAW THE HISTORIC CAPE FLORIDA LIGHTHOUSE IN 1825
draft.article: The Cape Florida Lighthouse marks a foundational chapter in local maritime history on Key Biscayne, with origins dating back to 1825. Established directly on Key Biscayne during that year, the historic beacon was constructed specifically to warn passing ships traversing the surrounding waters. Safe navigation was the primary objective for the coastal installation. From the time of its completion in 1825, the Cape Florida Lighthouse served its vital role on Key Biscayne, providing essential alerts to warn ships moving along the nearby coast.
